## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Verification

List checks performed, their results, relevant failed attempts and retries, and anything still unverified. For UI changes, include a screenshot without private data.

## Review

- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples match the change.
- [ ] Included files follow the privacy and third-party asset requirements in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/luquibu/nerditulos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Scope and known limitations are stated.
